items.name: vanafish
items.description: The Vanadreams fishing bot. Casts, reads the bite, decides catch or release by your rules, ends the fight the way the server judges it, stops itself when something is off. Works on any server.

items.name: charcapture
items.description: Snapshots your character for porting to Vanadreams: /capture in game, then send it from the launcher's Capture page. Reads only.

items.name: distance
items.description: Shows the distance to your target.

items.name: fps
items.description: Frame rate display and cap.

items.name: timestamp
items.description: Timestamps in the chat log.

items.name: tparty
items.description: Shows party members' TP and target HP.

items.name: recast
items.description: Ability and spell recast timers.

items.name: chatmon
items.description: Sounds and alerts for tells and chat.

items.name: itemwatch
items.description: Watch counts of items and key items on screen.

items.name: blumon
items.description: Blue Mage spell learning monitor.

items.name: blusets
items.description: Save and set Blue Mage spell sets.

v3.name: blusets
v3.note: v3 sets were JSON; v4 wants one spell per line in config\addons\blusets\<name>.txt.

items.name: checker
items.description: Shows level and evasion/defense on /check.

items.name: craftmon
items.description: Crafting results monitor.

items.name: filterless
items.description: Removes chat filters.

items.name: filterscan
items.description: Filters wide scan results.

items.name: links
items.description: Makes links in chat clickable.

items.name: mapdot
items.description: Shows your position on the map as a dot.

items.name: paranormal
items.description: Shows hidden nearby entities.

items.name: petinfo
items.description: Pet HP, MP and TP display.

items.name: repeater
items.description: Repeats a command on a timer.

items.name: affinity
items.description: Sets the game's CPU affinity.

v3.name: Affinity
v3.note: Was a plugin in v3; an addon in v4. Re-add /affinity set <mask> under the wait if you used one.

items.name: nokb
items.description: Disables knockback on you.

v3.name: No-ckback
v3.note: Was the No-ckback plugin in v3.

items.name: thirdparty
items.description: Lets outside programs talk to Ashita, the way WindowerInput did.

v3.name: WindowerInput
v3.note: Replaces WindowerInput.

items.name: screenshot
items.description: Screenshots with the chat log hidden.

items.name: minimap
items.description: A minimap overlay.

items.name: find
items.description: Finds an item across your bags, storage and slips.

items.name: Oseem
items.description: Augment tracking and control, all in its own window.

v3.name: Oseem
v3.note: Was a plugin in v3; an addon in v4 with no config files.

items.name: Lootwhore
items.description: Lots and passes the treasure pool by your rules.

v3.name: Lootwhore
v3.note: Profiles copied to config\lootwhore\profiles; check the drop and store lists once.

items.name: Bellhop
items.description: Moves items between bags and storage with one command.

v3.name: Bellhop
v3.note: Commands are /bh now; the legacy command names are switched back on for you.

items.name: Packer
items.description: Pulls the gear your sets need out of storage.

v3.name: DressMe
v3.note: Does what DressMe did; DressMe has no v4 version.

items.name: LegacyAC
items.description: Ashitacast for v4, reading your v3 gear XMLs as they are.

v3.name: Ashitacast
v3.note: Your Ashitacast XMLs were copied into config\LegacyAC. Commands are /la instead of /ac.

items.name: LuAshitacast
items.description: Gear swapping with Lua profiles, one per job. Wear a set and /lac addset <name> writes it into your profile; rules for weapon skills, spells, abilities, idle and engaged go in the same file. Same author as LegacyAC and Packer.

v3.name: Ashitacast
v3.note: The author's newer swapper. LegacyAC keeps reading your v3 XMLs; this is for building new jobs in game.

items.name: Multisend
items.description: Sends commands to your other characters.

v3.name: MultiSend
v3.note: Same groups file as v3, copied over.

items.name: FindAll
items.description: Searches every character's inventory at once: /fa search <item>.

v3.name: findall
v3.note: The v3 addon became this plugin. It rebuilds its own cache once each character has loaded.

items.name: XIPivot
items.description: Loads DAT overlays (HD textures, UI mods) without touching the game files.

v3.name: XIPivot
v3.note: Overlays moved from plugins\DATs to polplugins\DATs and the overlay list rewritten as config\pivot\pivot.ini. Enabled in the boot profile, not the script.

items.name: Vanadreams music
items.description: Vanadreams' own music on the title screen and character select, through XIPivot. Only our tracks are in it; the game's files are untouched. Needs XIPivot from this page.

items.name: crafty
items.description: Repeats a synthesis on Vanadreams: queue a crystal and ingredients with /crafty add, then /crafty start. Stops itself when materials run out or the bags fill.

v3.name: Crafty
v3.note: Written again as a v4 addon for Vanadreams; the v3 plugin had no v4 version.

v3.name: DressMe
v3.note: No v4 version; Packer does the job.

v3.name: WatchEXP
v3.note: No v4 version exists.

v3.name: lotomatic
v3.note: No v4 version; Lootwhore covers lotting and passing.

v3.name: pbar
v3.note: No v4 version; petinfo is the nearest bundled pet display.

v3.name: pupatt
v3.note: No v4 version; Sippius's pupsets sets attachments from a file.

v3.name: status
v3.note: No v4 version exists.

v3.name: synplicity
v3.note: No v4 version exists.

items.name: actionparse
items.description: Shows the contents of incoming action packets. A developer tool.

items.name: activemon
items.description: Shows an image on screen when this game window is the focused one. For people running more than one.

items.name: ahcolors
items.description: Recolours auction house listings so they are easier to read.

items.name: ahgo
items.description: Opens the auction house from anywhere and lets you walk with it open.

items.name: allmaps
items.description: Shows every map with /map without needing the key items, waypoints included.

items.name: aspect
items.description: Forces the game's aspect ratio to match the window.

items.name: autojoin
items.description: Handles party invites for you by your rules.

items.name: autologin
items.description: Logs into a chosen character slot on its own.

items.name: autorespond
items.description: Marks you AFK and answers tells with a set message.

items.name: blucheck
items.description: A window tracking which Blue Mage spells you have learned.

items.name: cartographer
items.description: Shows every map in the map menus, not just the zone you are in.

items.name: casper
items.description: Removes collision with other players: walk through them.

items.name: cfhblock
items.description: Blocks Call for Help so you cannot hit it by accident.

items.name: chamcham
items.description: Colours models by what they are: player, monster, NPC.

items.name: changecall
items.description: Replaces every call command with the one call sound you pick.

items.name: chatfix
items.description: Fixes private-server chat problems caused by a client update. Worth having on.

items.name: chime
items.description: Plays in-game chime sounds from a slash command.

items.name: cleancs
items.description: Hides Ashita windows during cutscenes.

items.name: clearcolor
items.description: Changes the background colour of the scene.

items.name: clock
items.description: Shows clocks on screen: local, server, Vana'diel.

items.name: config
items.description: Slash commands that set game settings directly.

items.name: crosshair
items.description: Draws position guide lines for lining up Ashita windows.

items.name: debuff
items.description: Cancel a status effect by command.

items.name: drawdistance
items.description: Slash commands for the scene render distances.

items.name: enternity
items.description: No more pressing Enter through NPC dialogue and cutscenes.

items.name: equipmon
items.description: Your equipment on screen all the time.

items.name: fastswap
items.description: Fixes the client getting stuck when you change jobs too fast.

items.name: filters
items.description: Save and load chat filter sets. Written for private servers.

items.name: freemem
items.description: Memory clean-up.

items.name: gateway
items.description: Every door is always open.

items.name: hideconsole
items.description: Slash commands to hide or show the boot loader window on private servers.

items.name: hideobs
items.description: Hides the game window from OBS capture.

items.name: hideparty
items.description: Slash commands to hide, show or toggle the party frames.

items.name: hideui
items.description: Slash commands to hide, show or toggle the Ashita windows.

items.name: ime
items.description: Lets non-Japanese clients type with the Japanese IME.

items.name: imguistyle
items.description: Per-character styling of the Ashita windows.

items.name: instantah
items.description: Removes the delay on auction house actions.

items.name: instantchat
items.description: Removes the delay on messages reaching the chat windows.

items.name: invmon
items.description: Your bag space on screen.

items.name: logincmd
items.description: Runs a script per character at login or on switching characters.

items.name: logs
items.description: Writes everything in the chat log to a file.

items.name: macrofix
items.description: Removes the macro bar delay when pressing Ctrl or Alt.

items.name: minimapmon
items.description: Hides the minimap when you stand still and in other cases you choose.

items.name: mipmap
items.description: Undoes a Square Enix patch that changed how mipmaps are set up.

items.name: move
items.description: Adjusts the game window: position, size, border.

items.name: namecolors
items.description: Edits the game's name colour table.

items.name: nomad
items.description: Mog house functions in any zone.

items.name: noname
items.description: Hides your own name.

items.name: onevent
items.description: Runs commands of your choosing when a chat event matches.

items.name: peekaboo
items.description: Makes every entity the client knows about visible.

items.name: quicksets
items.description: Removes the delay between equipment sets.

items.name: renamer
items.description: Renames entities with your own overrides.

items.name: sexchange
items.description: Change your race and hair style by command.

items.name: singlerace
items.description: Every player and NPC becomes one race and hair style.

items.name: skeletonkey
items.description: Forces closed doors open.

items.name: stepdialog
items.description: Presses the key to continue the current dialogue, by command.

items.name: stfu
items.description: Stops repeated game spam in chat and stops calls making sounds.

items.name: tokens
items.description: More tokens for the chat log to parse.

items.name: trimspells
items.description: Trims the Ctrl+M spell list to the spells you know.

items.name: truesight
items.description: Removes occlusion and shows invisible players half-transparent.

items.name: watchdog
items.description: Widescan tracking of nearly anything, by command.

items.name: hardwaremouse
items.description: Uses the hardware mouse cursor instead of the game-drawn one.

items.name: winefix
items.description: Fixes for running under Wine on Linux and Mac.

items.name: Sequencer
items.description: Stops actions double-registering when a gear swapper (LegacyAC or LuAshitacast) is changing your gear. The author recommends it with either.

items.name: tCrossBar
items.description: Controller macros with an on-screen crossbar, the FFXIV style.

items.name: tHotBar
items.description: Keyboard macro bars with an on-screen display.

items.name: tTimers
items.description: Time left on the buffs and debuffs you cast, and recast timers for your spells and abilities.

items.name: statustimers
items.description: Status effect timers on screen, replacing the game's icons.

items.name: mobdb
items.description: Information about the monsters around you, in the style of ibar.

items.name: Porter
items.description: Stores and fetches gear through the porter moogle. LegacyAC and LuAshitacast can drive it.

items.name: castdelay
items.description: Holds casts, ranged attacks and item use until you stop moving, so they are not interrupted.

items.name: XIUI
items.description: A replacement UI: player bar, target bar, party list, enemy list, exp and gil trackers. The most-used v4 project.

items.name: HitPoints
items.description: Your target and every enemy you are fighting, as HP bars on screen.

items.name: Balloon
items.description: NPC dialogue in speech balloons, with themes. A port of the Windower addon.

items.name: captain
items.description: Packet capture and analysis. For people helping build the server.

items.name: ScentHound
items.description: Tracks monster spawns with on-screen markers and sound alerts. For notorious monster camping.

items.name: hush
items.description: Hides yells, teleport requests and other chat noise.

items.name: Zonename
items.description: Shows the zone and region name for a moment when you zone. A port of the Windower addon.

items.name: SimpleLog
items.description: Combat and message log parser: a cleaner, filtered log window.

items.name: FancyTrusts
items.description: A window for calling and managing trusts.

items.name: boussole
items.description: A replacement for the in-game map with extra features.

items.name: Auctioneer
items.description: An easier auction house: search, buy and sell from one window.

items.name: Points
items.description: Tracks the points you are earning: exp, capacity, sparks, and more, on screen.
